operations.name: new_part
operations.summary: Creates a new part document from a template (or SolidWorks' configured default part template) and returns its identity. Always the first step of a build from scratch: call this before any other document-scoped operation, then pass the returned 'title' as documentName in every subsequent step.

params.name: templatePath
params.description: Absolute path to a .prtdot template. Omit to use SolidWorks' configured default part template (swDefaultTemplatePart).

operations.name: select_by_id
operations.summary: Selects (or adds to selection) one entity by name and type, populating the SolidWorks selection list that subsequent operations (extrude, fillet, pattern, ...) consume. Common type values: PLANE, FACE, EDGE, VERTEX, SKETCH, BODYFEATURE, AXIS, SKETCHSEGMENT, DATUMPOINT. mark distinguishes the role of a selection for a multi-selection feature (e.g. extrude_boss just needs mark 0 on the sketch/profile).

params.name: x
params.description: Hint point X, used to disambiguate overlapping entities; 0 is fine when the name is unique.

params.name: append
params.description: true to add to the current selection instead of replacing it.

params.name: mark
params.description: Selection mark/role — see the recipe that consumes this selection for the mark it expects.

params.name: callout
params.description: Always a null COM callout reference; not settable.

operations.name: clear_selection
operations.verifiedOn: SolidWorks 2026 SP3.0, live (tests/SeedVerifier/Zoo.Live.cs, called before every selection in the zoo build)

operations.name: insert_sketch
operations.summary: Starts editing a new 2D sketch on the currently selected plane or face. Select a plane first (select_by_id, type PLANE) then call this. SolidWorks' InsertSketch toggles sketch-edit mode — the same COM member also exits a sketch; see 'exit_sketch'.

operations.name: exit_sketch
operations.summary: Exits the currently active sketch, returning to the feature tree. SolidWorks' InsertSketch toggles sketch-edit mode, so this calls the same COM member as 'insert_sketch' — the difference is only the precondition and the expected resulting state.
operations.verifiedOn: SolidWorks 2026 SP3.0, live (tests/SeedVerifier/Zoo.Live.cs sk.InsertSketch(true) called a second time to exit)

operations.name: create_circle_by_radius
operations.summary: Adds a circle to the active sketch, centered at (centerX, centerY) in sketch space (centerZ is always 0 on a planar sketch). Requires an active sketch — call insert_sketch first. Use two calls with different radii, same center, to sketch a washer profile.

params.name: centerX
params.description: Sketch-space X of the circle center.

params.name: centerY
params.description: Sketch-space Y of the circle center.

operations.verifiedOn: SolidWorks 2026 SP3.0, live (tests/SeedVerifier/Zoo.Live.cs sk.CreateCircleByRadius(x,y,z,r), multiple calls)

operations.name: create_line
operations.summary: Adds a straight line segment to the active sketch, from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) in sketch space. Requires an active sketch — call insert_sketch first.
operations.verifiedOn: Signature-verified against SolidWorks.Interop.sldworks (ISketchManager.CreateLine(Double,Double,Double,Double,Double,Double) -> SketchSegment); not exercised by the live zoo build.

operations.name: extrude_boss
operations.summary: Boss-extrudes the pre-selected sketch profile by a blind depth, adding material to a solid body (or creating one). Select the sketch first (select_by_id, type SKETCH, mark 0), make sure no sketch is being edited (exit_sketch), then call this. Leave every param but depth1 at its default for a simple one-direction boss.

params.name: singleDirection
params.description: Sd — extrude in one direction only.

params.name: flipSideToCut
params.description: Flip — irrelevant for a boss; meaningful for a cut.

params.name: endCondition2
params.description: T2, direction 2 (only used when not singleDirection).

params.name: merge
params.description: Merge the result with the existing solid body.

operations.verifiedOn: SolidWorks 2026 SP3.0, live (docs/seed-verification.md; tests/SeedVerifier/Zoo.Live.cs fm.FeatureExtrusion3(...)). Note: only the FIRST extrude in a part reports IFeature.GetTypeName2()=='Extrusion' on this build; every subsequent extrude/cut reports 'ICE' (docs/seed-verification.md §4.1) — both are boss/cut extrudes, get_part_info's seed schema covers both type names.

operations.name: rebuild
operations.summary: Forces a rebuild of the document and reports whether it completed without errors.
operations.verifiedOn: SolidWorks 2026 SP3.0, live (tests/SeedVerifier/Zoo.Live.cs doc.ForceRebuild3; SwBridge DocumentStateProbes.RebuildSucceeded uses the same EditRebuild3 member)

operations.name: undo
operations.summary: Undoes the last N document edits. No operation ever triggers this automatically (ADR 0002: fail-fast, no auto-rollback) — call it deliberately to back out of a partial state after a failed step.
operations.verifiedOn: Signature-verified against SolidWorks.Interop.sldworks (IModelDoc2.EditUndo2(Int32) -> Void); not exercised by the live zoo build. See ADR 0002's open question on EditUndo3 reliability for compound API-driven state — EditUndo2 is used here as the simpler, documented member.
